verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a state business-filing agency like the Virginia SCC, so the axis applies. The pack holds only robots.txt probes: both SCC hosts disallow all crawling, and nothing was fetched. That leaves no evidence the service publishes processing times for any transaction type, and confidence is low because the content was never examined.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
